items.standfirst: Exclusive: Thirty-one trusts issue stark warning that cost-cutting demands threaten their ability to function normallyDozens of hospitals are so short of money they may not be able to continue caring for patients and are being forced to make “unpalatable” cuts to services and staff, the Guardian can reveal.Thirty-one health service trusts in England have issued stark warnings that NHS demands for them to make huge budget savings this year threaten their ability to function normally. items.standfirst: Steely Dan | Hot toddy | Dental advice | Christmas gifts | Black FridayI read with interest how Adrian Chiles traces his concentration challenges back to the CD shuffle button (Instant gratification is ruining our lives – and for me it started with my CD player’s shuffle button, 18 November). The simple solution is to play Aja by Steely Dan, in its glorious 39 minutes and 54 seconds’ entirety, and I promise you there will be absolutely no skipping or shuffling of tracks. Bren Pointer London• To mitigate the dental hygienist’s horror of a hot toddy (Letters, 20 November), how about having the hot water flavoured with sugar and lemon, followed by a swishing of the teeth with a generous helping of whisky?
